Workload Group Z Resource Get Workload Groups Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/workloadGroups/lite

Retrieves the list of workload groups.

⚠ This API endpoint is accessible only via OneAPI.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 20.

Default value: 20
Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The ID of the entity.

name
string

The name of the entity.

]
